mortal_wounds.wound: Your body lies cleaved in two, and the halves lay entangled like conjoined twins in bloody embrace.

mortal_wounds.condition: You are mortally wounded. You die unless healed to 1 hp within 1 round. If you are healed, you need 1 month of bed rest.
mortal_wounds.wound: Both your eyes were melted in the heat (blinded, -4 attack throws, no LOS, movement reduced to 1/3 normal, -2 to surprise rolls).
A ghastly cut across the belly reveals your harsh demise.
Your body lies cleaved into so many pieces that a butcher would find his work done for him.

mortal_wounds.condition: You are critically wounded. You die unless healed to 1 hp within 1 day. If you are healed, you need 1 week of bed rest.
mortal_wounds.wound: You struggle to draw breath through scorched and blackened lungs (must rest for 2 turns every 6, expedition speed reduced by 1/3, cannot force march, CON reduced by 1/3).

mortal_wounds.condition: You are critically wounded. You die unless healed to 1 hp within 1 day. If you are healed, you need 1 week of bed rest.
mortal_wounds.wound: The deep wound has destroyed your manhood/womanhood (cannot reproduce, -3 to reaction rolls if loss of manhood / womanhood is known).

mortal_wounds.condition: You are in shock. You recover with 1 hp. You need magical healing and one night of bed rest, or 1 week of rest.
mortal_wounds.wound: 1d3 fingers on one hand are burned off (3 lost fingers on one hand make it useless).

mortal_wounds.condition: You are grievously wounded. You die unless healed to 1 hp within 1 turn. If you are healed, you need 2 weeks of bed rest.
mortal_wounds.wound: One leg is hacked off (crutch is required, movement reduced by 30', DEX reduced by 1/3 for AC purposes).

mortal_wounds.condition: You are grievously wounded. You die unless healed to 1 hp within 1 turn. If you are healed, you need 2 weeks of bed rest.
mortal_wounds.wound: 3d6 teeth are broken inward by a forceful blow, leaving you slurring and gap-toothed (-2 to all reaction rolls, -1 to initiative when spellcasting).
